articles.title: Analog Devices to buy Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion
articles.description: In a significant move, Analog Devices has agreed to purchase Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash. This acquisition is set to enhance ADI's on-device capabilities amidst the growing trend of AI technology infiltrating physical systems.

articles.title: Analog Devices will pay $1.35bn for edge AI chipmaker Alif Semiconductor
articles.description: Analog Devices will acquire Alif Semiconductor for $1.35bn in cash plus up to $200mn contingent, adding edge AI microcontrollers that run neural networks inside devices.
articles.content:
